title: SalesWorkQueueSettings - Data API
description: Represents settings used to customize work queue options for third-party scoring. Third-party scoring enables custom number fields on person accounts, contacts, and leads. You must be a Sales Engagement customer to update this object. Previously, you could only use the Einstein Intelligence Score for third-party scoring. Available starting in Version 47.0.

FeatureName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
FeatureName.description: A value that represents the name of the work queue settings. To use custom number fields in the work queue, the value must be entered as ThirdPartyScore.

TargetEntity.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TargetEntity.description: The related record object of the custom number field. Acceptable SObjects include PersonAccount, Contact, and Lead.

TargetField.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TargetField.description: A value that represents the DeveloperName of the custom number field related to the TargetEntity. Custom fields must have a custom number data type. To use Einstein Intelligence Score for lead scoring, enter ScoreIntelligence.Score for the DeveloperName. To remove custom number fields from the work queue, enter None.
